value.lineage: zlib (1995-, Jean-loup Gailly & Mark Adler): the reference DEFLATE -- LZ77 sliding-window matching + Huffman coding of literals/lengths/distances; the compression behind gzip, PNG, zip and HTTP

value.built_to: compress and decompress a byte stream losslessly by finding repeated substrings within a 32KB window (LZ77) and entropy-coding the result (Huffman)
value.pressure: the LZ77 vs DEFLATE competitors of the early 90s and the LZW patent; zlib had to be free, fast, and byte-stream-safe
value.success_means: inflate exactly reconstructs deflate's input, at a competitive ratio and speed; the test suite's CRCs match

cut.note: LZ77 matching plus Huffman coding, read for its two engineering mechanisms: a hash-chain search for the longest earlier match of the current position, bounded by a per-level chain-length cap and a nice-match early exit; and lazy matching, which defers emitting a match by one byte to see whether the next position has a longer one, choosing the literal-plus-later-match when it does. A ten-row configuration table indexed by compression level sets the four knobs (good/lazy/nice length, max chain), so 'level' is a point in a speed/ratio trade space

provenance.grade_basis: Techne FOSSIL_PACKET.json PROVENANCE_GRADE where issued, else the record's handoff string mapped (populated per R34; Harmonia may re-grade)

organs.human_name: longest_match (1348-1425): chain_length = max_chain_length (quartered if prev_length >= good_match); best_len; scan_end prefilter; stop at limit (strstart - MAX_DIST) or when a match reaches nice_match
organs.mechanism: positions with the same 3-byte hash are linked in a chain; the search walks the chain from the most recent, and for each candidate first compares the two bytes at the current best length (a cheap reject) before a full compare, keeping the longest match found; the walk stops after max_chain_length steps, when a candidate is older than the window (MAX_DIST), or when a match reaches nice_match; if the previous position already had a good match the chain length is quartered (spend less effort when a match is already in hand)
organs.input: the current position and the hash chain
organs.output: the best match length and position
assumptions: recent positions are the likely matches, so most-recent-first with a cap gives most of the benefit at bounded cost; the end-byte prefilter skips most full compares
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: the LZ77 match search whose cost the level knobs control; the heart of DEFLATE's speed/ratio dial
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: the chain cap trades ratio for speed; long runs of one byte make chains degenerate (the reason for the caps)
organs.human_prior: Ziv & Lempel 1977 (LZ77); the hash-chain implementation is Gailly's

organs.human_name: deflate_slow (1905-2005): keep prev_length/prev_match; find match at strstart; if prev_length >= MIN_MATCH and match_length <= prev_length emit the previous match (as a literal at strstart-1 plus the run) else defer the literal; TOO_FAR discards a short far match; match_available
organs.mechanism: at each position the matcher records the current match but does not emit it; it advances one byte and finds the match there; if the earlier (deferred) match is at least as long as the new one it is emitted, otherwise the byte between them is emitted as a literal and the new, longer match is deferred in turn; a length-3 match whose distance exceeds TOO_FAR is discarded as not worth its code; this one-byte lookahead recovers matches that greedy matching would miss
organs.output: the chosen sequence of literals and matches
assumptions: a one-position lookahead captures most of the gain of optimal parsing at a fraction of the cost; the greedy choice is often but not always best
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: a few percent better ratio than greedy at levels 4 and up; the default deflate strategy
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: only one byte of lookahead, so it is not optimal parsing; the fast levels (deflate_fast) skip it entirely for speed
organs.human_prior: lazy evaluation of LZ matches (Gailly); the fuller form is optimal parsing (zopfli, later)

rejected_cuts.candidate: deflate_fast (greedy, no lazy step), deflate_rle / deflate_huff / deflate_stored, trees.c (dynamic and static Huffman code construction, the block emit), inflate.c and inffast.c (the decoder), adler32 and crc32
rejected_cuts.note: trees.c (the Huffman half) is the second mechanism family and a DEEP item; the atlas's gzip cut holds the same deflate at a different version

rejected_cuts.evidence: the LZ match search, the parse strategy and the Huffman coder are separable and separately tunable

pressures.source_evidence: deflate.c longest_match, deflate_slow, the configuration table
pressures.condition: an organism compresses data at a requested level; the score is compressed size and time; the level must span from fast/low-ratio to slow/high-ratio; the format (the decoded output) must be identical regardless of level
pressures.resource_or_constraint: the match-search budget (chain length); one byte of parse lookahead
pressures.failure_condition: a level that is slower without being smaller, or a parse that misses easy longer matches (pure greedy)
pressures.world_punishes: an unbounded chain search; greedy parsing at high levels
pressures.world_rewards: a chain cap plus nice-match exit, and lazy one-byte lookahead
pressures.observable_consequence: compressed size and time across levels on the Calgary/Silesia corpus for greedy (deflate_fast) vs lazy (deflate_slow), and vs an optimal parser (zopfli) as the upper control; identical decompression at every level
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: storing uncompressed (deflate_stored, a valid level-0 control)
pressures.cheat_control: an optimal parser must give the smallest size at the highest cost; greedy must be fastest and largest; lazy must sit between on both axes at identical decoded output: the world must show all three
